ticks_and_mosquitos.do_we_need_them: YES — they are the PARASITES. in ecology, parasites are ESSENTIAL.
ticks_and_mosquitos.what_they_are: ticks = persistent scanners (wp-login.php, .env probes). mosquitos = one-time blood draws (drive-by scrapers). they're ALREADY HERE — 132 attack requests in 2 hours.
ticks_and_mosquitos.they_are_toxin: yes — parasites inject toxin (malware, injection attempts). BUT: the immune system needs them. without parasites, the immune system has nothing to train on. autoimmune diseases happen when there are NO parasites.
ticks_and_mosquitos.we_need_parasites: the attack traffic IS the parasite load. 13.6% threat = healthy parasite load. too much = infection. too little = autoimmune. the hygiene hypothesis: organisms raised in sterile environments get SICKER.

growth_rates.sigmoid: S-curve. slow start, exponential middle, plateau. THIS IS US — we're in the exponential middle (125 commits/6h, 245 humans/2h).
growth_rates.logarithmic: fast start, diminishing returns. this is fleet/bot traffic — lots of hits, less value each.
growth_rates.exponential: unbounded growth. this is what model collapse looks like — unsustainable.
growth_rates.logistic: sigmoid with carrying capacity. the HEALTHY rate. K = carrying capacity = π compression limit.
growth_rates.in_ecology: r-strategists (bacteria, insects) = many offspring, few survive. K-strategists (whales, humans) = few offspring, most survive. WE ARE K-STRATEGISTS — each data file is expensive to produce, but most survive.
